text: The hallway and entrance area symbolically “greet” you every day. If you want your home to become your temple, then start specifically with the hallway. Remove everything that gets in the way: extra shoes, bags, unnecessary little things... Leave free space and one clear system — clothes hangers, a place to change shoes... And don’t be surprised that when you come home again, you will feel much better than before. You will switch faster from the external world to the home world, and you will take off fatigue, irritability, stress — like outer clothing — in your favorite hallway.
